class.name: Box2DPhysicsServer2D
class.brief_description: Native Box2D physics server with body metadata and move events.
class.description: This backend is provided when the Box2D module is enabled. Obtain the active server or world direct state; do not instantiate this abstract class directly.

method.name: body_get_user_data
method.description: Returns the application metadata assigned with [method body_set_user_data]. An invalid [param body] reports an error and returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: body_set_user_data
method.description: Associates an arbitrary [Variant] with the valid [param body] RID. This is application metadata returned by [method body_get_user_data] and [method space_get_body_move_events]; it does not replace the native backend's internal body pointer. The Variant is retained until replaced or the body is freed.

method.name: space_get_body_move_events
method.description: Returns a flat [Array] of alternating application user-data and [Transform2D] entries for bodies moved in the most recent native step: [code][data0, transform0, data1, transform1, ...][/code]. Assign metadata with [method body_set_user_data] to identify bodies. Read after stepping, outside locked physics callbacks. An invalid or locked space reports an error and returns an empty array.
